_notes: Hand-built catalogue. Every image in website/site/assets/images was visually inspected and tagged.  Key insight: ~70% of 'asset' files actually show Wes in action — these are now tagged person:wes and routed to brand/work hints rather than generic asset hints, so anonymous-equipment posts get anonymous-equipment images.

boiler-repair.webp.shows: Modern Ideal combi boiler wall-mounted in a kitchen. Digital display reads 48°C HEATING. Clean copper pipework with magnetic filter. White subway tile backsplash. Sink and worktop in foreground.

boiler-fitting.webp.shows: Wes (navy polo, no logo visible) holding a new Worcester Bosch combi boiler being lifted into position on a wall. Bare wall behind, packaging on floor.

boiler-heatex-clean-vs-dirty.webp.shows: Two Baxi heat exchangers side by side on a Baxi service mat. Left one clean (silver fins), right one filthy with carbon/debris build-up. Pure before/after pair.

boiler-systems.webp.shows: Wes standing in a utility room next to a Worcester combi + unvented cylinder + UFH manifold. Branded polo. Full system showcase.

combi-boiler-installations.webp.shows: Wes kneeling next to an installed Worcester combi, holding a copper pipe section, tools on dust sheet. Mid-job.

stripped-old-boiler.webp.shows: Old white-cased boiler with cover removed, exposed dirty interior with electronics, against wall with a clock. Looks knackered — perfect 'before' shot.

system-boiler-cylinder.webp.shows: Worcester unvented hot water cylinder beside wall-mounted Worcester combi with copper pipework and isolation valves. No person.

worcester-loft-install.webp.shows: Worcester combi installed against bare concrete-block wall in a loft, copper pipework, Magnaclean filter, manifolds. No person.

heating-radiator.webp.shows: Clean white panel radiator on a wall in a cosy living room. Sofa with knitted throw, plant, framed botanical art. Stock-style.

radiators.webp.shows: Wes (logo'd navy polo) using a screwdriver on a panel radiator in a hallway. Working hands-on, kneeling.

central-heating.webp.shows: Wes kneeling in a utility cupboard, holding a Fluke multimeter against opened Worcester boiler control panel. Tools on floor. Washing machine visible.

power-flushing.webp.shows: Wes kneeling next to a black Kamco power flush rig, holding orange flush hose connecting to boiler. ADEY MagnaClean visible. Mid-flush.

powerflush-kit.webp.shows: Outdoor shot of the Kamco power flush rig + accessories on pallets in a yard. Equipment only, no person.

system-flushing.webp.shows: Wes (blue gloves, branded polo) pouring jet-black sludge water from an ADEY MagnaClean filter into a clear bucket. Dramatic sludge-reveal shot.

neat-copper-manifold.webp.shows: Tidy run of parallel copper pipes against a wall with a black magnetic filter mounted. Floor lifted. Tradesman porn — clean install.

copper-pipework.webp.shows: Close-up of copper pipework with multiple junction fittings and a brass compression fitting. Against neutral wall. Detail shot.

gas-safety.webp.shows: Domestic gas meter installation: yellow gas pipes, Elster BK-G4 meter, brass valves and isolation taps. Clean equipment shot.

gas-services.webp.shows: Wes outdoors at an external gas meter cabinet, holding clipboard, inspecting. Low-res small image.

gas-appliance-servicing.webp.shows: Wes in a kitchen lifting a gas hob unit out of the worktop, tools visible (wrench, tape measure, flexi-hose). Mid-removal.

gas-pipe-installation.webp.shows: Wes kneeling on dust sheet, soldering copper pipe under wall-mounted boiler. Brass fittings laid out. Persil bottle visible.

gas-leak-detection.webp.shows: Wes kneeling next to a gas hob in kitchen, using an electronic gas leak detector with LED probe. Looking focused at the appliance.

heating-controls.webp.shows: Wes in a hallway using a screwdriver on a Nest-style round thermostat dial on the wall. Mid-install.

smart-controls.webp.shows: Wes installing a Nest smart thermostat on the wall, while another hand (customer) holds a phone showing the Nest app set to 18°C. Two-hand composition.

plumbing-repairs.webp.shows: Chrome mixer tap in a kitchen with running water into a white sink, garden visible through window. Stock-feel.

bathroom-shower.webp.shows: Modern walk-in shower with rain head running water, glass screen, white subway tile, white sink unit. Clean stock-style.

shower-repair.webp.shows: Wes in beige-tiled bathroom holding a thermostatic shower cartridge, examining recessed shower valve. Mid-repair.

showers.webp.shows: Wes in white-tiled bathroom using a yellow spirit level to align a shower riser rail. Mid-install.

tap-before-corroded.webp.shows: Heavily limescaled chrome tap, thick black build-up around base, on wooden worktop. Disgusting close-up.

tap-after-chrome.webp.shows: Clean chrome mixer tap on wooden worktop, white sink, blinds in background. Paired 'after' shot.

tap-repair.webp.shows: Wes in a kitchen holding a blue tap cartridge, new replacement cartridge in packaging on worktop. Mid-repair.

taps.webp.shows: Wes under a sink, looking up while fitting a chrome tap from below with both hands. Tight space.

outdoor-taps.webp.shows: Wes kneeling outdoors against a wall, installing an outdoor garden tap with a yellow drill nearby. Small low-res image.

toilet-repair.webp.shows: Wes in a bathroom lifting the lid off a toilet cistern, tool bag on floor. Mid-repair.

toilet-repairs.webp.shows: Wes holding a brass flush mechanism removed from a toilet cistern, replacement parts laid on cistern lid.

pipe-leak-repair.webp.shows: Wes under a kitchen sink with a torch, holding a wrench, looking up at the waste pipe. Mid-inspection.

small-plumbing-jobs.webp.shows: Wes kneeling under a kitchen sink, using a wrench on plastic waste pipework. Towel laid for spill. Mid-job.

water-tank-services.webp.shows: Wes beside a Tribune unvented hot water cylinder in a cupboard, holding a pressure gauge connected to the cylinder.

plumber-tools.webp.shows: Plumber's tools laid flat on wooden surface: Fluke multimeter, adjustable wrench, Ridgid pipe cutter, copper elbow fittings, pipe bender, PTFE tape. Clean overhead flat-lay.

van-work.webp.shows: Black Ford Transit Custom SWB panel van parked on the driveway of a modern UK home with side door open. Wide shot, no person.

southampton-cityscape.webp.shows: Aerial sunset shot of Southampton skyline showing the bridge over the Itchen, marina, river, and city buildings. Iconic local hero shot.
